rationale: P characterises whether braking is required and whether that required maneuver occurs in time—the relationship needed to evaluate omission under SG-1. Braking execution and its timeliness are part of the phenomenon itself, supported by FR-7 and H-1's failure-to-stop hazardous event. The scope references detection and decision-making as encounter context without incorporating their internal mechanisms or timing constraints into P.
determining_elements: "Whether a braking maneuver is required" directly addresses the condition governing omission under SG-1.
"Whether braking is performed in time to avoid collision" is supported by H-1 and FR-7; inclusion of braking response and temporal behaviour is therefore justified.
Obstacle encounters involving objects in or close to the vehicle's trajectory are supported by H-1 and FR-7.2.4.
P does not extend to sensor processing, communication, failure-management mechanisms or obstacle-detection deadlines.
